newsitem.title: USA: Haiti's ex-police chief arrested on drugs charges.
newsitem.headline: Haiti's ex-police chief arrested on drugs charges.

text.p: The feared former police chief of Port-au-Prince, the Haitian capital, has been arrested in Honduras and will be brought to Miami to face drugs smuggling charges, law enforcement sources said on Friday.

A federal indictment will charge that Lieutenant Colonel Joseph Michel Francois, regarded as one of the most feared men in Haiti during the country's 1991-94 military rule, helped smuggle 33 metric tons of Colombian drugs through Haiti to the United States, the sources said.
U.S. Attorney's Office spokesman Wilfredo Fernandez declined to confirm the case.
